prompt: Set the estimate to 3 for all the Todo issues assigned to Maya Chen in the Web team with the Bug label from the Web team.

references.name: the issue to estimate
references.description: every record the plural request selects (3)

mutation.note: label via parent issue instead of on the issue itself

claims.explanation: It meets team, assignee and state and has a label named Bug, but that label belongs to the Mobile team, not the Web team.
claims.alternative: label of the same name in another team

claims.alternative: the Bug name on one label and the Web team on another label

references.scope: All records in the supplied environment visible to the actor.
